messages:
Kira Nakamura: Quick thread to capture a minimal spec for tenant-tiering lanes and regional failover choreography. We need clear gating for product to include this in the roadmap, plus a low-friction migration path for enterprise customers.
Devon Park: By tenant-tiering lanes do you mean per-tenant preference + isolation bands? I'd like to avoid full shard migration for V1.
Kira Nakamura: Exactly. Tiering lanes = preference + guarded fallback. Goals: legal residency respect, predictable latency, and an ops-friendly evacuation flow.
Luisa Mendes: Product launch gates: opt-in pilot only, billing delta visible, signed residency agreement if required, rollback SLA (we can revert within 30m), and CS approval for pilot tenants.
Harold Grant: Infra notes: need affinity store per-tenant, route-table versioning, and a fast rollback switch. Also require a preflight capacity validator for any planned migrations.
Kira Nakamura: Telemetry required before canary: tenant p50/p95/p99, fallback-hit-rate, cross-region egress GiB, requeues on fallback, and route-table change audit. Dashboards + alerts mandatory.
Devon Park: Propose gating thresholds: dry-run (no traffic) for 24h, 1% canary for 24h (p95 latency <= +10% and error delta <=0.5pp), then 10% for 12h, then gradual ramp.
Luisa Mendes: I'll own customer comms and the opt-in checklist. Need a one-page FAQ about what evacuation means and potential egress billing.
Harold Grant: CLI snippets for ops/devs: 
```bash
# inspect affinity
redwoodctl routing affinity get --tenant t42 --env prod
# dry-run migration
redwoodctl routing affinity set --tenant t42 --region eu-west-1 --dry-run
# force fallback (emergency)
redwoodctl routing fallback force --tenant t42 --ttl 3600 --reason "region degraded"
```
QA-bot: Test plan note: include synthetic failover tests, end-to-end latency checks, and an automated dry-run validation that verifies traffic pins before live cutover.
Kira Nakamura: Action items: 1) Luisa draft opt-in + FAQ (due Wed) 2) Harold spike route-table versioning + preflight tool (due Fri) 3) Devon build telemetry dashboard template (due Thu) 4) Kira coordinate pilot tenant list and CS approvals (due Mon).
Devon Park: Booked a 30m gate review next Tue 9am PT to sign off. If we pass, add tenant-tiering lanes to Q3 roadmap and schedule a 3-customer pilot. :rocket:
